title: Provenance-led access streamlining for geofenced audit bundles
creator: Samir Rao
description:
Background: Customers in regulated regions require audit-ready evidence that user access changes obey data residency and retention policies. Current access evidence flow is fragmented: SCIM deltas, SSO session logs, and RBAC policy versions live in separate streams. This ticket consolidates provenance metadata, attaches residency tags, and emits canonical audit bundles for periodic access review automation.

Goal: Build a lightweight access provenance pipeline that: (1) ingests SCIM change events and SSO session attestations, (2) correlates these with tenant residency metadata and retention windows, (3) produces signed evidence bundles consumable by compliance reporting and periodic attestation jobs, and (4) surfaces anomalies to the Console and automated reviewers.

Scope: prototype pipeline and schema, automations for monthly access attestation for geofenced tenants, SCIM delta reconcilers, and a proof-of-concept Console card for reviewers. Not in scope: RBAC UI redesign, enterprise legal review for final audit language.
acceptance_criteria: SCIM delta stream consumer that annotates events with tenant residency and retention policy id
Evidence bundle proto/schema that includes event provenance, signed snapshot link, and retention TTL
Automated job that generates monthly attestation reports per tenant and pushes to compliance archive with retention metadata
Console reviewer card showing last attestation status, pending anomalies, and link to evidence bundle
Unit and integration tests for SCIM reconciliation covering delta out-of-order and duplicate events

progress_updates: 2026-02-16: Kickoff with PM and Security. Agreed bundle must include a signed manifest and residency tag. Security requested HSM signing support for later rollout.
2026-02-22: Prototype SCIM consumer implemented; handles create/update/delete deltas and writes normalized events to internal event store. Tests for idempotency added.
2026-02-28: Residency metadata table design complete. Edge case: tenants that change residency need versioned residency tags; added residency_version field to schema.
2026-03-02: First end-to-end run created a bundle for test-tenant-eu; Console card mockups accepted by PM, minor copy changes requested.
2026-03-03: Discovered out-of-order SCIM events cause snapshot divergence for high-churn accounts. Mitigation: temporary watermark buffer and event reordering window (configurable).
links: Security ticket: ENG-128901 (adaptive-access-recertification) - reference for attestation schedule
risks: Signing key management scope creep if customers require HSM-per-tenant; mitigation: MVP uses platform signing and documents HSM integration as next step.
High event churn could inflate bundle size and processing cost; mitigation: include sampling/compact-diffs and retention TTL on bundles.
Residency changes mid-cycle could create ambiguous evidence; mitigation: embed residency_version and historical residency window in bundle.
decisions: Use platform-signed JWT manifest for MVP rather than per-tenant HSM signatures
Evidence bundles stored in encrypted S3 with retention metadata and signed manifest for integrity checks
SCIM consumer will maintain a reordering buffer configurable per-tenant to accommodate downstream eventual consistency
